rows.en: The Mobile Doll commander Gaddess has been driven off and the control device destroyed. The objective is to stop the particle cannon. Press on.
You found the particle cannon's control room in the Control Room. Head for the stairs to the Middle Layer.
The particle cannon is about to fire!! Go outside through the Ride Gate that appeared and destroy the particle cannon!
The particle cannon fired, but the base narrowly avoided a direct hit. Hurry to the Terminal Unit.
Deathscythe Hell and the others destroyed the particle cannon, but there were 4 giant weapons in all. First, check the Terminal Unit.
The heroes split into three squads and began the operation to destroy the giant weapons. Destroy the power source on the Lower Layer.
The heroes defeated Devil Gundam. They try to contact the Gundam Team, but can't get through. Follow the route the Gundam Team took.
The Gundam Team was attacked by Gaddess. Destroying the Libra Cannon has been entrusted to the Hero Team. Hurry to the Libra Cannon control room!!
With a strong heart that bows to no evil, Gundam Epyon stopped the Libra Cannon from firing. Press on toward the remaining Colony Laser.
We were attacked by Reborns and the others, but made it through with our allies' strength. Seravee and the others are in danger! Chase Gaddess!
Veda has been recaptured. The chance to finally defeat Reborns has come. Chase Reborns!!
The heroes finally defeated Reborns. After returning to base, head for a new Cube through the Ride Gate in the deepest part of Veda Cube.
Chasing Belial led us to the Monster Graveyard, where kaiju and aliens sleep. Be careful as you press on.
Belial has used the power of the Plasma Spark to revive the kaiju the heroes defeated!! Watch out for the revived kaiju as you advance.
You defeated the waiting Pteranodon Yummy. What is the ultimate being...? Chase after the Memory Memory that flew away.
The key to completing the Memory Memory's data was the heroes' feeling of "despair." Pass through the scattered warp zones and press on.
Grand Master Gundam is defeated, and Devil Gundam's fusion with the Cube has been stopped! Take the path the tentacles had blocked.
Belial's revived "King Pandon," "Zetton" and "Tyrant." Defeat the resurrected strongest kaiju and open the door!
You defeated King Pandon, the twin-headed kaiju Belial revived! Press on and defeat the remaining 2.
You defeated Zetton, the space dinosaur Belial revived! Only 1 left! Hurry on!
All the kaiju Belial sent have been defeated. The door should be open now. Head for Belial, who awaits beyond the door.
The Memory Memory is complete! Belial is waiting in the back hall. Go, heroes! Defeat Belial!
The fight was not over. The source of it all lies deep within the Genocide Cube. Heroes, restore peace!!
An unknown Cube has been discovered. Try pushing through the northeast outer wall of Ultra Cube with the new drill.

notes.note: Source names the Control Room and the cannon's control room; merged into one clause.
Pteranodon Yummy: gender variant (male/female) not specified in source; used the generic name.
Used 'Planate Defenser' to match the item-name table (descriptions elsewhere say 'Planet Defenser').
'Pseudo GN Drive' is the franchise-official rendering of the pseudo solar furnace; not in glossary.

report: All 80 rows translated. Uncertain: 'Memory Memory' (Gaia Memory name, not in glossary), 'Pseudo GN Drive', Planate/Planet Defenser spelling, 'Lower Layer' for the lower level. New terms: Memory Memory, Pseudo GN Drive, Mobile Doll, Particle Cannon, Colony Laser.
